note: Schoen affair - fabricated data, never replicated
text: Room-temperature superconductivity at 300 K in a single organic crystal: an unprecedented breakthrough. We observe zero electrical resistance far beyond any prior material. No independent laboratory has replicated the result, and the underlying data were later retracted.

note: STAP cells - failed to replicate, retracted
text: A miraculous acid-bath method (STAP) reportedly reprograms mature somatic cells into pluripotent stem cells. Independent groups failed to reproduce the effect, and the papers were retracted.

note: Wakefield MMR-autism - uncontrolled case series, retracted
text: A case series of twelve children reported a link between the MMR vaccine and autism. The study was uncontrolled, unblinded, and was later fully retracted for methodological and ethical failures.
Tabletop cold fusion producing anomalous excess heat at room temperature. Numerous independent laboratories observed no significant excess heat and failed to reproduce the claim.

We report the unprecedented creation of patient-specific embryonic stem cell lines by somatic cell nuclear transfer, a revolutionary breakthrough. The results were subsequently found to be fabricated and were retracted.

In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial (n=1961), semaglutide produced a mean weight loss of 14.9% versus placebo (p<0.001). The effect was independently replicated across multiple clinical centers.
A systematic review and meta-analysis pooling 42 randomized trials (n=58000 participants) found a consistent, statistically significant benefit (p<0.001) with low heterogeneity across studies.
A preregistered, controlled evaluation (n=500 tasks) reported a robust improvement that was independently reproduced by three separate teams (p<0.001).
